limit_preserved.rationale: The paraphrase preserves disturbance, concurrent or reused materials, repetitive patterns, observer error, unreliable anchors, insufficient overlap, unequal durations, discrete author-controlled features, chance agreement, dating restrictions, recopying, archival alteration, circularity, and the absence of supplied draft facts.

no_added_operational_content.rationale: Expanded organization and restatement introduce no additional action, measurement, threshold, evidence source, or inference permission. Operational details remain grounded in the mapping.

original_evidence: the counterpart of an increment

no_source_imagery.rationale: Source-domain terminology and counterpart imagery are removed. The remaining duration and external-condition statements describe limits of the target leaves and features while retaining manuscript entities.

no_verdict_language.rationale: Neither text asserts ordinariness, novelty, creativity, disciplinary nativeness, mere formalization, material departure, or the presence or absence of a new warrant. The inferential_warrant field describes conditional evidential support without making such a verdict.
